posts.cooked:
If I've put this in the wrong section, mods, please put it where you think it fits.

If you look at the Fan Art thread, a while ago I made Absolute Zero in DC Universe Online. It just so happens that I have 4 more character slots that I can make, so I'm opening it up to the forum. Which Sentinels characters should I make?

I thought about making the rest of the Freedom Five, but the character models are too restrictive to make Bunker, so it can really be anyone!

Villains are open for choice too, since the game lets you play as either.

 

I don't have all the DLC packs (there are 11 of them!) so some powers and fighting styles aren't available to me, so there are a few characters I can't make, at least not properly.

 

So I'm looking for suggestions. Suggest a character to me, and I will make them, and put screenshots up here for you to see (including some updated Zero ones, I've recently changed his design a little)

posts.cooked:
For those who are wondering how I get the different dances, during character creation you are able to set a character's Personality. This defines their stance and a few of their emotes, the most obvious being /dance. Some of the others that change are /wave and /rest, but they're far less fun.

Ra has the Powerful Personality, Absolute Zero doesn't dance because he is Serious, and Apostate is Primal.

Some of the dances also are affected by gender and personality together, but I don't remember which ones.
